title: TRICARE Reserve Select Family-Adjustment Relief - Premium Accounting Bulletin
content:
**Premium accounting bulletin - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

## The calculation

The family-adjustment relief is nothing: only days after the plan's termination date are counted, nothing is relieved for them per day, nothing is posted now, and the result is rounded to the cent.

## Terms

- **The adjustment worked from.** Every coverage-type adjustment billed for the most recently paid month, over the days those adjustments cover, ending on the last day of the month.
- **Month concerned.** The most recently paid month, the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles.
- **Assembly.** The family-adjustment relief figured is the number of relieved days, from the first day counted through the last day of the month, multiplied by the daily amount withdrawn; what is posted is the part of it posted now, rounded to the cent once, at the end, and never less than zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Coverage-type adjustment bills for June total 88.24 and cover 11 days, 20 to 30 June; the plan's termination date is 25 June. The days counted are those after it, 26 to 30 June, 5 days; nothing is relieved for them per day, so 5 multiplied by 0.00 is 0.00, and nothing is posted now. The family-adjustment relief is 0.00.
